sources.name: GitHub issues of Hacker0x01/react-datepicker
sources.version: GitHub REST API 2022-11-28, state as of 2026-11-11
sources.license: GitHub Terms of Service (user content; only facts and our own summaries are kept)

provenance.notes: URL, number, title, state, dates, counts and labels are copied from the API response of each issue. Category, components, summary, resolution and lesson are written by the researcher (tools/extract/field-reports/curation) after reading the issue body returned by the search API and, for the issues listed in docs/research/field-reports.md, the full thread. daysOpen of an open issue is measured to the retrieval date. fixedBy is filled mechanically from merged pull requests that name the issue after a closing keyword. Reports marked needs-review state a cause that the researcher inferred from the symptom without a confirming statement in the issue.

reports.title: how can i change the direction of the days from right to left?
reports.summary: With a Hebrew or Arabic locale the calendar still ran its weekdays and dates from the left, and no prop changed it. Open for nineteen months, closed as won't fix.
reports.lesson: A calendar grid follows direction automatically.

reports.title: Any plans on supporting Hijri calendar?
reports.summary: A one-line question about plans for the Hijri calendar; closed as won't fix a year and a half later.

reports.title: rtl clear button
reports.summary: In RTL the clear button sat on top of the input's text, since it is absolutely positioned on the right.
reports.lesson: Clear and other adornments use logical insets and reserve logical padding.

reports.title: keyboard navigation does not work with rtl language
reports.summary: With an RTL locale the left arrow key acted as right and vice versa in the calendar. Closed as won't fix.
reports.lesson: Arrow-key mirroring is part of the calendar-grid engine.

reports.title: How can I 'invert' the direction of the months arrows while using an RTL language
reports.summary: A user could not invert the month navigation arrows for an RTL language; wrapping the picker in a dir="rtl" element did not do it. Closed as won't fix.
reports.lesson: The dir of any ancestor is enough for previous/next to swap sides and mirror.

reports.title: Month skip issue on hijri calendar
reports.summary: In a Hijri setup, selecting one of the last days of a month and navigating skipped a month. Closed as won't fix.
reports.lesson: Month navigation in non-Gregorian calendars adds months in that calendar's arithmetic, clamping the day, and is tested at 29/30-day boundaries.

reports.title: add rtl support
reports.summary: A request for an RTL prop to adapt styles and keyboard shortcuts, with ten reactions, was closed as stale after more than two and a half years.
reports.lesson: Same opening as elsewhere: an RTL-correct, Hijri-capable date picker.
